measurement_intent: L1 cache bandwidth work-amount sweep. HIP/CUDA rows use a fixed L1-resident working_set_size; Go simulator rows use per-256-thread read-group reuse, so total simulator input allocation grows with num_elements.

scaling_parameter.name: num_elements
scaling_parameter.description: Selected comparison problem_size axis: output elements/threads. Work scales with this axis. HIP/CUDA keep working_set_size fixed; Go simulator keeps each 256-float read group fixed and allocates ceil(num_elements / 256) * 256 input floats. Total read bytes are num_elements * repeat_count * bytes_per_read, with repeat_count named num_iterations in HIP/CUDA and num_repeats in Go.

work_model.description: Default HIP/CUDA measured work for the L1 cache-bandwidth probe. Go simulator rows use num_repeats for the same repeat-count role and follow simulator_input_bytes_formula rather than a fixed total working_set_size.

working_set_size.description: Fixed L1-resident input footprint in bytes for HIP/CUDA workload rows; not exposed by the current Go simulator sample

block_size.description: Thread block size for kernel launches

num_iterations.description: HIP/CUDA name for repeated read iterations per output element; Go simulator flag is num_repeats

stride.description: Stride between consecutive memory accesses (in elements)
